faqs.question: What is web accessibility and why does it matter?
faqs.answer: Web accessibility ensures that websites, tools, and technologies are designed and developed so that people with disabilities can use them effectively, understand content, and navigate without barriers.

faqs.question: What are WCAG guidelines?
faqs.answer: The Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) are internationally recognized standards developed by the W3C. They outline criteria for making web content accessible across four core principles: Perceivable, Operable, Understandable, and Robust.

faqs.question: Can you make our existing website accessible without rebuilding it?
faqs.answer: Yes! We conduct thorough accessibility audits and implement remediation directly into your existing codebase and design system to achieve full compliance without needing a complete redesign.

faqs.question: How do you test websites for accessibility?
faqs.answer: We utilize a combination of automated testing tools (like axe-core and Lighthouse) and rigorous manual testing using real assistive devices, screen readers (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver), and keyboard-only navigation.

faqs.question: Will web accessibility improve our search engine optimization (SEO)?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Many accessibility best practices—such as semantic HTML5 tags, proper heading hierarchy, descriptive alt text, and fast load times—are direct ranking signals for major search engines like Google.
